description: December 4 birthday meaning: Sagittarius decan 2, birthday number 4, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a December 4 birthday falls in Sagittarius, in the second decan, with Jupiter as the sign's ruler and Mars as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 4. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Sagittarius is mutable and fire.

sections.heading: Personality of a December 4 birthday
paragraphs: The 4th of December pairs restless fire with patient structure. With the Sun near twelve degrees of Sagittarius, the Mars decan pushes for action and adventure, and the birthday number 4 favours planning and steady effort. The combined reading suggests an expedition organiser: someone who dreams of the mountain and also remembers to pack the right rope.

By noon UTC on December 4, the Sun has normally reached roughly 12° of Sagittarius. That places the date in the Sagittarius decan that astrologers give to Mars, the second of three. Mars, ruler of Aries, acts as sub-ruler for the middle of Sagittarius, roughly December 2 to December 11. The sign's love of freedom picks up a sharper, more competitive edge. Early-December birthdays are frequently linked with bold, energetic people who are quick to champion a cause, whether on a playing field, in a debate or on the road. Their honesty may be direct enough to startle. Mars brings drive and courage, along with impatience when life moves slowly. Channelled well, this mix of vision and nerve makes for a natural pioneer, someone willing to test an idea in the real world.

sections.heading: Numerology of the December 4 birthday
paragraphs: A 4th-of-the-month birthday gives a birthday number of 4, with no further reduction needed. In numerology the birth day acts as a supplementary number, describing practical talents that sit beside the Life Path. The 4 stands for the square: four walls, four seasons, a stable base. Anyone born on the 4th is often pictured as organised, trustworthy and good at turning plans into schedules. They tend to prefer a method that has been tested to one that merely sounds exciting. The growing edge for 4s is usually flexibility, letting the structure bend when circumstances genuinely change.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same December 4 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 7 for 1980, 8 for 1990, 9 for 2000 and 1 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: December 4 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: December birthdays arrive at the start of northern winter, around the shortest days and the year's festivities, and at the start of summer in the southern hemisphere. Sagittarius holds most of the month, with Capricorn beginning around December 21 or 22. In numerology December is month 12, which reduces to 3: expression and sociability, built from the 1 and 2 of initiative and partnership. December 4 is the 338th day of the year (339th in a leap year). In most years Capricorn season is under way by December 22, 18 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a December 4 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. December 4 is also the birthday of Rainer Maria Rilke (1875), Thomas Carlyle (1795) and Wassily Kandinsky (1866).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is December 4?
faq.answer: December 4 is Sagittarius in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Sagittarius, which tradition links with Mars.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on December 4?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On December 4 the Life Path is 5 in 1960, 6 in 1970, 7 in 1980, 8 in 1990, 9 in 2000, 1 in 2010 and 11 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 4 for everyone born on the 4th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on December 4?
faq.answer: By December 4 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on December 4?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a December 4 birthday are Rainer Maria Rilke (1875), Thomas Carlyle (1795) and Wassily Kandinsky (1866). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
